# FIXTURE: bad-03 — רָאָה perfect at line end + כִּי-clause on next line
# Violation: see-verb (qal perfect, bare form ראה) split from complement
# Note: wayyiqtol וַיַּרְא bare=וירא does NOT contain ראה; use perfect form רָאָה instead
# Rule: H7/complement-integrity, STRONG-MERGE-CANDIDATE
# Expected: ≥1 finding

1:1
וַיִּשְׁמַע יוֹנָה וַיֵּדַע רָאָה
כִּי טוֹב הַמָּקוֹם׃
